name: @molcrafts/molvis-plugins-official
description: Official MolVis page plugin collection (meta + per-plugin packages)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-lammps-input-generator && npm run build -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-alchemist && npm run build -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-pyodide-molpy && npm run build:meta
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-lammps-input-generator && npm run typecheck -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-alchemist && npm run typecheck -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-pyodide-molpy && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-lammps-input-generator && npm run test -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-alchemist && npm run test -w @molcrafts/molvis-plugin-pyodide-molpy
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
